title: Inner-Layer Fine-Tuning with Frozen Boundaries
scientific_hypothesis: The 0.0006 headroom to perfect score is controlled primarily by phase matching in inner layers (positions 2, 6, 7); freezing outer layers (0, 1, 8, 9) and restricting inner perturbations to ±2 nm around iteration_15 optimum will converge faster to local optimum without destabilizing boundary conditions.
design_principle: Local quasi-Newton refinement around proven high-performing parameters with constrained search space to avoid regression observed in iteration_11.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Silicon substrate (10 finite layers, alternating high-low starting with Ta2O5)
manufacturing_considerations: ±2 nm tolerance on optimized layers represents tight but achievable process control
frozen outer layers reduce total variable count for faster convergence
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method sensitivity analysis shows inner layers dominate phase matching for dual-band AR
Local optimizer convergence improves with reduced parameter space when near optimum
expected_advantages: Avoids regression seen in iteration_11 by stabilizing boundaries
known_risks: May miss global optimum if frozen outer layers are suboptimal
±2 nm constraint may be too restrictive if optimum lies outside this range
execution_request_english: Optimize a 10-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 anti-reflection stack on silicon substrate. Initialize all layers with thicknesses from iteration_15 best candidate: [41.05, 124.86, 186.61, 196.64, 77.45, 105.93, 142.41, 256.06, 117.42, 35.56] nm. Freeze layers 0, 1, 8, 9 at these values. Optimize only layers 2, 6, 7 with bounds [thickness_initial - 2 nm, thickness_initial + 2 nm]. Minimize mean reflectance over 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm bands at 0 deg unpolarized incidence. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate 0.01. Report best_target_score, robustness_score, and final thicknesses. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to fine-tune inner phase-critical layers while freezing outer boundaries, based on iteration_15's 0.9994 score and 0.0006 remaining headroom.
